//go:build functional

package metaengine_test

import (
"context"
"fmt"
"io"
"log/slog"
"net"
"os"
"path/filepath"
"testing"
"time"
quorum "github.com/asalimonov/gquorum"
"github.com/asalimonov/gquorum/internal/metastore"
"github.com/asalimonov/gquorum/topology"
)

func TestCaptureNativeBaseline(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	root := t.TempDir()
	listener, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() { _ = listener.Close() })
	opts := quorum.NodeOptions{StorageDir: root, Identity: topology.Identity{NodeName: "n1", ClusterID: "cluster", InstanceID: "source"}, Node: topology.Node{Name: "n1", Type: "worker"}, Bootstrap: quorum.BootstrapOptions{Founders: []quorum.FoundingMember{{Node: topology.Node{Name: "n1", Type: "worker"}, MemberID: 1, Address: listener.Addr().String()}}}, Meta: quorum.MetaOptions{SnapshotThreshold: 8, Network: quorum.MetaNetworkOptions{Listener: listener, AdvertiseAddress: listener.Addr().String(), AllowPlaintext: true, ClusterCredential: []byte("credential")}}, Logger: slog.New(slog.NewTextHandler(io.Discard, nil))}
	node, err := quorum.NewNode(opts)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
		defer cancel()
		if err := node.Stop(ctx); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
	})
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(t.Context(), 10*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	if err := node.Start(t.Context()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := node.WaitReady(ctx); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	session, err := node.ActivateSession(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for index := range 27 {
        if err := node.Cluster().AcquireLock(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("capture/%d", index), session.ID); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    }
	if err := node.Stop(ctx); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
    store, err := metastore.Open(filepath.Join(root, "_meta.bolt"))
    if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    retained, err := store.LoadAll()
    if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    if err := store.Close(); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    t.Logf("snapshot=%d term=%d commit=%d tail=%d", retained.Snapshot.Metadata.Index, retained.Snapshot.Metadata.Term, retained.HardState.Commit, len(retained.Entries))
    if retained.Snapshot.Metadata.Index <= 1 || retained.HardState.Commit <= retained.Snapshot.Metadata.Index { t.Fatal("need nonempty snapshot plus committed tail") }
    for _, name := range []string{"_meta.bolt", "_authority.bolt"} {
        data, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, name)); if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
        if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join("/tmp/gquorum-baseline-native-output", name), data, 0600); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    }
}
